top_signals.title: China Water Environment Seeks $410 Million Loan Restructuring
top_signals.summary: China Water Environment Group, one of the nation’s largest sewage treatment firms, is seeking to restructure about $410 million of offshore loans, according to people familiar with the matter, adding to a growing number of Chinese state-backed firms facing debt challenges.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Alleged AI-aided cyberattack exploits assistant interface to breach German web host
top_signals.summary: Hackers allegedly assisted by AI breached a German web hosting company through a tool designed to allow customers to connect AI assistants to their accounts, the company disclosed.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
